title: White-Haired Warrior Poses
description: Three views of a dark-skinned woman with long flowing white hair wearing a red and black outfit with a flowing red coat, red gloves and boots. The left and right images show her in a low crouching pose while the center image shows her dynamically leaping with one leg raised and hands emitting red magical energy.
